//: Phase 2: the REAL TypeScript compiler checks these files, but they stay
plain .js with the types written in JSDoc comments.
Why not .ts files: the test suite proves a module has no hidden page
globals by require()ing it directly in bare Node - that is how toRad,
OM_LEVELS and flights were caught. With .ts sources Node cannot load
them without a compile step, so that guard would be testing compiled
output instead of the source. Same checker, same errors, no new build
step, and the annotations carry over unchanged if we ever do move.
noEmit: nothing is generated. This is a checker, not a build.
